prBodyNotes: Bot PRs carry no changeset. If this PR changes a published package's behavior, add a patch changeset per [Changesets](https://github.com/PerfectPan/agent-presence/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#changesets) before merging.

Lock-file-only updates need no changeset. Check whether a bundled dependency changed a published package's behavior and add a patch changeset if so; see [Changesets](https://github.com/PerfectPan/agent-presence/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#changesets).

This group shares a seven-day release-age policy and allows mixed major/minor updates. Different publication dates can still make packages eligible separately; grouping does not solve exact Effect peers. Require `pnpm peers check --lockfile-only` and the single-Effect alignment test in `pnpm test` to pass before merging.
